title: The Relational Leadership Podcast
author: UpWordsUnlimited.com
description: Leonard and Steve discuss all things related to Relational Leadership. As you listen, you’ll discover how this form of leadership can help you improve your performance in business and improve your personal life. Relational Leaders are focused on Purpose, Principles, People and Profits. We believe there are four constants of success: Conversation, Connection, Collaboration, and Community. We’ll explore all these concepts and more as we take a deep dive into Relational Leadership.
